Chief_Complaint.content: Upper lip swelling after eating prawn soup
Chief_Complaint.source_text: CC: Upper lip swelling after prawn soup

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Upper lip swelling began about 30 minutes after eating prawn soup at approximately 19:00
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Timeline: Ate ~19:00; swelling began ~30 min later

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Swelling started at the left upper lip corner and progressed to involve the entire upper lip
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: started L upper lip corner → now upper lip

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient describes the lip swelling as 'pumping' and getting worse
Patient feels she 'can’t breathe that well'
Patient is unsure if she has chest tightness
Patient felt dizzy during the call
Similar episode about one year ago after late-night Chinese food with next-morning significant swelling and difficult breathing
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Similar episode ~1 yr ago after late-night Chinese; next morning “quite swollen” with difficult breathing

Past_Medical_History.content: History of peanut allergy since childhood
As a child, patient reportedly needed an injection for an allergic reaction
Past_Medical_History.source_text: As a child reportedly needed an injection

Past_Medical_History.content: Hospitalized at approximately age 6 for a severe allergic reaction
Past_Medical_History.source_text: hospitalized at ~age 6 for severe reaction (per pt/mum)

Medications.content: Patient uses a salbutamol inhaler regularly
Patient is not using a 'brown' inhaler (preventer inhaler)
Patient sometimes takes antihistamines but is unsure which ones
Patient had no antihistamines on hand initially during this episode

Social_and_Family_History.content: Patient was initially alone during the reaction and her mother later arrived with antihistamines
Social_and_Family_History.source_text: Context: Initially alone; mother later present with antihistamines

Assessment.content: Suspected anaphylactic reaction after prawn soup with progressive lip swelling, shortness of breath, and dizziness, onset about 30 minutes after exposure, in a patient with peanut allergy, prior severe reaction, and asthma
Assessment.source_text: 1. Suspected anaphylactic reaction after prawn soup — progressive lip swelling, SOB, dizziness; onset ~30 min post-exposure; hx peanut allergy/prior severe reaction; asthma

Assessment.content: Asthma managed with short-acting beta agonist (SABA) only

Plan_of_Care.content: Mother instructed to call emergency services (999) immediately for suspected anaphylaxis and stay with the patient until the ambulance arrives
Plan_of_Care.source_text: For 1: Mother to call 999 now (suspected anaphylaxis); stay with pt until ambulance arrives

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to take available antihistamine immediately while awaiting the ambulance
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Take available antihistamine immediately while awaiting ambulance

Plan_of_Care.content: After hospital discharge, patient to call clinic to arrange follow-up regarding 'injections' as discussed
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Post-hospital: call clinic to arrange follow-up re “injections” (as discussed)

Follow_up_Information.content: Post-hospital follow-up with clinic to be arranged regarding injections
Follow_up_Information.source_text: Post-hospital: call clinic to arrange follow-up re “injections” (as discussed)
